segments.sn44.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn44.1:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena khemā bhikkhunī kosalesu cārikaṃ caramānā antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ toraṇavatthusmiṃ vāsaṃ upagatā hoti.
segments.sn44.1:1.3: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo sāketā sāvatthiṃ gacchanto, antarā ca sāketaṃ antarā ca sāvatthiṃ toraṇavatthusmiṃ ekarattivāsaṃ upagacchi.
segments.sn44.1:1.4: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn44.1:1.5: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, toraṇavatthusmiṃ tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā jāna yamahaṃ ajja payirupāseyyan”ti.
segments.sn44.1:2.1: “Evaṃ, devā”ti kho so puriso rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā kevalakappaṃ toraṇavatthuṃ āhiṇḍanto [anvāhiṇḍanto (sī.)] nāddasa tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā yaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo payirupāseyya.
segments.sn44.1:2.2: Addasā kho so puriso khemaṃ bhikkhuniṃ toraṇavatthusmiṃ vāsaṃ upagataṃ.
segments.sn44.1:2.3: Disvāna yena rājā pasenadi kosalo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn44.1:3.1: “Natthi kho, deva, toraṇavatthusmiṃ tathārūpo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yaṃ devo payirupāseyya.
segments.sn44.1:3.2: Atthi ca kho, deva, khemā nāma bhikkhunī, tassa bhagavato sāvikā arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segments.sn44.1:3.3: Tassā kho pana ayyāya evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.sn44.1:4.1: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yena khemā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā khemaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo khemaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn44.1:4.2: “kiṃ nu kho, ayye, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:4.5: “Kiṃ panayye, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:4.8: “Kiṃ nu kho, ayye, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:4.10: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn44.1:4.11: “Kiṃ panayye, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti.
segments.sn44.1:4.13: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn44.1:5.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, ayye, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti, iti puṭṭhā samānā –
segments.sn44.1:5.2: ‘abyākataṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā – hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn44.1:5.4: ‘Kiṃ panayye, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭhā samānā –
segments.sn44.1:5.5: ‘etampi kho, mahārāja, abyākataṃ bhagavatā – na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn44.1:5.7: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, ayye, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭhā samānā –
segments.sn44.1:5.8: ‘abyākataṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā – hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn44.1:5.10: ‘Kiṃ panayye, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭhā samānā –
segments.sn44.1:5.11: ‘etampi kho, mahārāja, abyākataṃ bhagavatā – neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn44.1:5.13: ‘Ko nu kho, ayye, hetu, ko paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā’”ti?
segments.sn44.1:6.1: “Tena hi, mahārāja, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.sn44.1:6.2: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, atthi te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti gaṅgāya vālukaṃ [vālikaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] gaṇetuṃ – ettakā [ettikā (sī.)] vālukā iti vā, ettakāni vālukasatāni iti vā, ettakāni vālukasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni vālukasatasahassāni iti vā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:6.6: “Atthi pana te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti mahāsamudde udakaṃ gaṇetuṃ – ettakāni udakāḷhakāni iti vā, ettakāni udakāḷhakasatāni iti vā, ettakāni udakāḷhakasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassāni iti vā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:6.11: “Evameva kho, mahārāja, yena rūpe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.sn44.1:6.12: Rūpasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:6.14: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti.
segments.sn44.1:7.1: “Yāya vedanāya tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, sā vedanā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn44.1:7.2: Vedanāsaṅkhāyavimutto, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:7.4: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti.
segments.sn44.1:8.1: “Yāya saññā tathāgataṃ … pe … yehi saṅkhārehi tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, te saṅkhārā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn44.1:8.3: Saṅkhārasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:8.5: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti.
segments.sn44.1:9.1: “Yena viññāṇe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ viññāṇaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.sn44.1:9.2: Viññāṇasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:9.4: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upetī”ti.
segments.sn44.1:9.5: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo khemāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā khemaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.sn44.1:10.1: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aparena samayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn44.1:10.2: “kiṃ nu kho, bhante, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:10.5: “Kiṃ pana, bhante, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:10.8: “Kiṃ nu kho, bhante, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:10.10: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn44.1:10.11: “Kiṃ pana, bhante, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:10.13: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn44.1:10.14: “Kiṃ nu kho, bhante, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.sn44.1:10.15: ‘abyākataṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, mayā – hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi … pe ….
segments.sn44.1:10.16: “‘Kiṃ pana, bhante, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.sn44.1:10.17: “‘etampi kho, mahārāja, abyākataṃ mayā – neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn44.1:10.19: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:11.1: “Tena hi, mahārāja, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.sn44.1:11.2: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, atthi te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti gaṅgāya vālukaṃ gaṇetuṃ – ettakā vālukā iti vā … pe … ettakāni vālukasatasahassāni iti vā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:11.5: “Atthi pana te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti mahāsamudde udakaṃ gaṇetuṃ – ettakāni udakāḷhakāni iti vā … pe … ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassāni iti vā”ti?
segments.sn44.1:11.10: Evameva kho, mahārāja, yena rūpena tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.sn44.1:11.11: Rūpasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:11.13: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti.
segments.sn44.1:11.15: Yāya vedanāya … pe … yāya saññāya … pe … yehi saṅkhārehi … pe …”.
segments.sn44.1:12.1: “Yena viññāṇena tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, taṃ viññāṇaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.sn44.1:12.2: Viññāṇasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.sn44.1:12.4: ‘Hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upeti,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipi na upetī”ti.
segments.sn44.1:13.2: Yatra hi nāma satthu ceva [satthuno ceva (sī.)] sāvikāya ca atthena attho byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṃsandissati, samessati, na virodhayissati [vihāyissati (sī. syā. kaṃ.), vigāyissati (ka.)] yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ.
segments.sn44.1:13.3: Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ khemaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ apucchiṃ.
segments.sn44.1:13.4: Sāpi me ayyā etehi padehi etehi byañjanehi etamatthaṃ byākāsi, seyyathāpi bhagavā.
segments.sn44.1:13.6: Yatra hi nāma satthu ceva sāvikāya ca atthena attho byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṃsandissati, samessati, na virodhayissati yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ.
segments.sn44.1:13.10: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmīti.

lines: Abyākatasaṃyuttassa paṭhame khemāti gihikāle bimbisārassa upāsikā saddhāpabbajitā mahātherī “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ mahāpaññānaṃ yadidaṃ khemā”ti evaṃ bhagavatā mahāpaññatāya etadagge ṭhapitā.
Yena rūpena tathāgatanti yena rūpena dīgho rasso sāmo odātoti sattasaṅkhātaṃ tathāgataṃ paññapeyya.
Taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnanti taṃ vuttappakārarūpaṃ samudayappahānena sabbaññutathāgatassa pahīnaṃ.
Rūpasaṅkhāya vimuttoti āyatiṃ rūpassa anuppattiyā rūpārūpakoṭṭhāsenapi evarūpo nāma bhavissatīti vohārassapi paṭipassaddhattā rūpapaṇṇattiyāpi vimutto.
Gambhīroti ajjhāsaya gambhīratāya ca guṇagambhīratāya ca gambhīro.

Tassa evaṃ guṇagambhīrassa sato sabbaññutathāgatassa yaṃ upādāya sattasaṅkhāto tathāgatoti paññatti hoti, tadabhāvena tassā paññattiyā abhāvaṃ passantassa ayaṃ sattasaṅkhāto hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti idaṃ vacanaṃ na upeti na yujjati, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātiādivacanampi na upeti na yujjatīti attho.
Aṅgulimuddāya gaṇanāya kusaloti aṅgulikāya eva gaṇanāya kusalo seyyathāpi pādasikā.
Tathāgatoti khīṇāsavo, tathāgataṃ sandhāya pucchatīti khīṇāsavoti cassa arahattaphalavasibhāvitakhandhe upādāya ayaṃ paññatti hoti.
Tesu khandhesu sati khīṇāsavā sattasaṅkhātā hontīti vohārena paññapetuṃ sakkā bhaveyya, asantesu na sakkā, tasmā paraṃ maraṇāti vuttattā tesaṃ abhāvā “abyākatametan”ti vuttaṃ.
Yadi evaṃ tesaṃ abhāvato “na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti puṭṭhāya “āmā”ti paṭijānitabbā siyā, taṃ pana sattasaṅkhātassa pucchitattā na paṭiññātanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Yena rūpenāti sattatathāgate vuttarūpaṃ sabbaññutathāgate paṭikkhipituṃ “taṃ rūpan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Khemāya theriyā vuttaṃ paṭhamaṃ suttaṃ bhagavato seṭṭhatthadīpanato aggapadāvacaraṃva hotīti vuttaṃ “aggapadasmin”ti.
